collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — LUCK, OMENS AND LAVASTONES (LO-01 to LO-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager always steps out left foot first for luck, and a doubting friend decides to test it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) always puts (subject.his/her) left foot out of the door first in the morning. Always. It brings a good day. (friend), who doesn't believe in any of it, has decided to test the idea by walking out right foot first every single morning for a week, and reporting back.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: They swap. (subject) goes right foot first for a week, and spends every day braced for disaster. Nothing bad happens, except that (subject.he/she) is so jumpy (subject.he/she) drops three bowls. (friend) goes left foot first, and has the most relaxing week of (friend.his/her) life. Neither of them is sure what this proves.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: At the end of the week, they compare. (subject) had a good week: a nice catch, a fun evening, one sore back. (friend) also had a good week: a nice catch, a fun evening, one stubbed toe. They look at each other. "Inconclusive," says (friend). "Except for the toe," says (subject).
